Auth.loginSubtitle: To save favourites and manage your home business or stall.

Akaun.title: My account

Welcome.title: Welcome!
Welcome.subtitle: Your account is ready. What should we call you?

AkaunKedai.title: My shop
AkaunKedai.registerSubtitle: It's free. Let people nearby find your small business and message you directly on WhatsApp.
AkaunKedai.step1: Fill in your business details and how people can reach you.
AkaunKedai.step2: Our admin checks and approves it, usually within 1 to 2 days.
AkaunKedai.step3: Add your catalog: items, prices and photos.
AkaunKedai.catalogSubtitle: What you sell, with prices and photos. You can add items while waiting for approval.
AkaunKedai.deleteHint: This deletes your business, catalog, photos and reviews. It can't be undone.

pending.title: Being reviewed
pending.body: Our admin is checking your business. It will appear in Peniaga Kecil once approved.

approved.title: Your business is live
approved.body: People can find you on the map and in search. Changes you save show straight away.

rejected.title: Not approved yet
rejected.body: Fix the details below and press "Save and resubmit".

Admin.title: Admin
Admin.subtitle: Add and manage pasar and stalls.
Admin.slugHint: The end of the link, e.g. tapaulahh.com/pasar/pasar-malam-seksyen-7. Leave empty and we'll make one from the name.
Admin.slugHintEdit: If you change it, old links people have shared will stop working.

pasarStatus.activeHint: Visitors see it on the map, in search and on its page.
pasarStatus.inactiveHint: Not shown to visitors. For pasar that have closed, or details that aren't ready yet.

vendorStatus.activeHint: Visitors see it on the pasar page.
vendorStatus.pendingHint: Hidden until the details are checked.
vendorStatus.inactiveHint: The stall is gone, or taking a break.

pasarForm.name: Pasar name
pasarForm.descriptionHint: What's good, how big it is, tips for first-timers.

fieldErrors.invalid: Not valid. For links, use only lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens (-).
